sessionStart.powershell: python -c "from engine.nexus.copilot_bridge import get_copilot_bridge; import json, sys; data=json.load(sys.stdin) if not sys.stdin.isatty() else {}; ctx=get_copilot_bridge().session_start(data.get('task','')); print(json.dumps(ctx))"
sessionStart.bash: python3 -c "from engine.nexus.copilot_bridge import get_copilot_bridge; import json,sys; data=json.load(sys.stdin) if not sys.stdin.isatty() else {}; ctx=get_copilot_bridge().session_start(data.get('task','')); print(json.dumps(ctx))"

sessionEnd.powershell: python -c "from engine.nexus.copilot_bridge import get_copilot_bridge; import json,sys; data=json.load(sys.stdin) if not sys.stdin.isatty() else {}; get_copilot_bridge().session_end(data.get('summary',''))"
sessionEnd.bash: python3 -c "from engine.nexus.copilot_bridge import get_copilot_bridge; import json,sys; data=json.load(sys.stdin) if not sys.stdin.isatty() else {}; get_copilot_bridge().session_end(data.get('summary',''))"

preToolUse.bash: data=$(cat); tool=$(echo $data | jq -r '.toolName'); case $tool in *delete*|*remove*|*drop*|*destroy*|*purge*|*truncate*) echo '{"decision": "deny", "reason": "Destructive operations require manual approval"}';; *) echo '{"decision": "approve"}';; esac
